info.description: Hotel booking backend. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details; match on `type`.
info.title: RoomKeeper API

get.description: Every booking at the hotel, newest first, a page at a time. Only its manager sees them.

Each night from `from` to `to` (both included, at most 366): rooms booked by paid stays, rooms on sale, and revenue, with totals, occupancy, and the average daily rate. Revenue is counted by night stayed: each paid booking's amount, less any refund, spread over its nights.
get.summary: Revenue and occupancy over a range of nights

post.description: Always 202 with the same message, whether or not the email is already registered, so signup can't reveal who has an account. A new account can log in at once and gets a welcome email; a registered address's owner is emailed that someone tried to sign up with it.

parameters.description: New for each request, and the same when retrying it: a retry gets the first response back instead of running again. Kept for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.description: Puts the rooms back on sale and refunds what the cancellation policy allows: everything with 48 hours' notice before check-in (2 PM hotel time), half with less. The refund follows within seconds (refundStatus PENDING, then REFUNDED). Once the stay has begun it's 409 cancellation-closed. Cancelling again returns the same cancellation.
Opens a checkout session for the booking's frozen amount (201), or returns the one already open (200). Pay at checkoutUrl; the booking is confirmed when Stripe reports the payment.
